about.description: SKUU is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on MEXC, tracking GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
